why: This is a straight state simulation: a hash map username -> password for registrations and a set of logged-in users. Each request is a constant-time lookup and update, applied in order.
hints: What state must you remember between requests? Exactly two things.
A dict of registered users and their passwords, and a set of users currently logged in. Each command checks and updates those.
Split each request, branch on the verb, do O(1) dict/set work and append the message. O(total length).
pitfalls: Logging in an already logged-in user fails, even with the right password.
Copy the exact messages: "Register Unsuccessfully" and "Login Unsuccessfully" are not grammatical but must match.
Logout of a registered but not logged-in user fails.
